subject: [PATCH v5 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed two issues raised by Sashiko: fixed an fd leak and handled waitpid() failure properly. The patch is ready for further review.

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch series adds a new test case to the selftests/mm suite, covering a shared-source collapse write race in the kernel's memory management system. The test checks that CoW (Copy-On-Write) isolation survives a collapse racing with writes to the shared source. The parent process writes to the shared range throughout the child's collapse, ensuring that CoW keeps the two apart.
